entries.339d1ac7dad194d3: This is the back-office business related to securities operations, conducted by consolidated subsidiary Iwai Cosmo Business Service Co., Ltd. It is classified under “Other,” which is not included in reportable segments, and operating revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥16 million.
entries.364f5eec1c988eea: It has both face-to-face sales and internet trading as sales channels, and in face-to-face sales it focuses on proposal-based sales of US shares. In internet trading, in September 2025 it introduced passkey authentication, the industry's first, making multi-factor authentication mandatory at login, and it has also taken a leading approach on security. Its distinguishing features also include its history since its founding in 1915 and its status as a securities group headquartered in Osaka.
entries.3d7627194ae6fdf2: This is the business segment covering the company itself as a holding company, and it is responsible for formulating and promoting group management strategy and running the group.
entries.4f8ca1ef4686d233: Its head office is in Imabashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka City. Consolidated employees as of March 31, 2026 numbered 848. Its predecessor was Iwai Shoten, a spot stock trading business founded in 1915 in Kishiwada City, Osaka Prefecture, and it transitioned to a holding company structure in 2010.
entries.5725004b0e90c9ce: Of operating revenue of ¥32,260 million, the Iwai Cosmo Securities segment accounts for ¥32,232 million, almost all of it, while operating revenue from external customers of the holding company itself and the back-office business is minimal. The filing states as a risk that revenue from the financial instruments business, its main business, may decline due to trends in stock market conditions and other factors.
entries.5b4d0d483e54264e: It is an internet trading service launched in 1998.
entries.5de2097b4d02bbdb: Commissions received (brokerage commissions, underwriting and offering fees, investment trust trustee fees, etc.)
entries.6b73883ddec91c8c: This is the financial instruments business conducted by consolidated subsidiary Iwai Cosmo Securities Co., Ltd. It buys and sells securities, brokers trading of securities, underwrites and conducts offerings of securities, and provides services through both face-to-face sales and online trading channels. Operating revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥32,232 million, accounting for the majority of consolidated operating revenue. The breakdown is trading gains and losses of ¥17,556 million, fee and commission income of ¥11,442 million, and financial revenue of ¥3,233 million.
entries.6d719c4fe0458015: Most revenue comes from the financial instruments business of Iwai Cosmo Securities, where trading gains and losses are the largest component, followed by commissions received, so the structure is one in which buoyant stock market conditions push up revenue. To increase revenue that is less affected by market conditions, stable revenue is being strengthened through investment trust trustee fees and the expansion of margin trading balances.
entries.7a2ef877e1e6572f: Face-to-face sales and brokerage of trading in stocks and other securities
entries.7bfba3e68cf67ffe: Revenue consists of commissions received, including brokerage commissions; trading gains and losses, mainly over-the-counter trading of US shares; and financial income, mainly margin trading income. Operating revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥32,260 million, up from ¥25,750 million in the previous fiscal year, a record high.
entries.7eb37232b0da43fe: Through face-to-face sales by sales staff, it handles trading in stocks and other securities, including U.S. stocks, which have continued to perform well, and brokerage of such trading.
entries.82db08968a207385: Individual investors who invest in stocks, investment trusts and other products
entries.95d424d9f6728917: Its main customers are individual investors who invest in shares and investment trusts. Operating revenue from external customers in Japan exceeds 90% of consolidated operating revenue, and there are no specific customers accounting for 10% or more of operating revenue from external customers.
entries.9e2c1f2980e5cac1: This is the back-office business related to securities operations, conducted by consolidated subsidiary Iwai Cosmo Business Service Co., Ltd.
entries.b4b55b161a43cbb5: Underwriting and secondary offerings and handling of offerings
entries.b61b60f3fa308dd4: The group comprises the company and 2 consolidated subsidiaries: its core subsidiary, Iwai Cosmo Securities, conducts financial instruments business through face-to-face sales and internet trading, and Iwai Cosmo Business Service conducts back-office operations for securities and other businesses.
entries.b975c25b91b0c833: Its core subsidiary, Iwai Cosmo Securities, conducts trading of shares and other securities, brokerage of consigned trades, sales of investment trusts, and underwriting of securities through face-to-face sales and internet trading (“Kosumo Nettore”). Operating revenue from external customers of Iwai Cosmo Securities for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥32,232 million.

entries.d5ca955d2d0c6056: This is based on operating revenue from external customers by reportable segment stated in the segment information, and on market fluctuation risk described in the business risks.
entries.da74b7dfb1c91292: This is based on the initiatives of Iwai Cosmo Securities described in the overview of operating results, among others (proposal-based sales of US shares, investment trust sales activities, introduction of passkey authentication), and on its history.
entries.de4ad59c4ea3288d: A holding company group centered on its securities subsidiary Iwai Cosmo Securities, engaged in financial instruments business such as brokerage and underwriting of stocks and investment trusts.
entries.df62b4a992ca20eb: As its basic policy, it sets out a “Customer First principle” that gives top priority to the best interests of customers, and says it aims to build firm relationships of trust with customers by providing products and services suited to each customer's trading preferences and risk tolerance. The 6th Medium-Term Management Plan, starting from the fiscal year ended March 2026 and running through the fiscal year ended March 2028, is built on customer-centered business operations, and aims to strengthen the customer base through IT-enabled sales promotion, grow assets under custody, promote DX and invest in human capital, and practice an all-hands management style in which management, managers and general employees act as one.
entries.e3caa48aa1792fa6: This is the business segment covering the company itself as a holding company, and it is responsible for formulating and promoting group management strategy and running the group. Operating revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥10 million, and most of the segment’s operating revenue came from internal transactions with group companies.
